name: Chinese (Simplified)
modelReview: rebuilt 2026-11-12 by Claude Fable 5.2 from a rule book redecided natively after two schedule reads and three blind fluency reads of the rows; 153 of 153 held-out rows pass on the first judged run (tooling/experiments/renderer-process/zh-acceptance.md); audited 2026-11-13 by Claude Fable 5.2 (an adversarial read of the renderer and of every row against its schedule, a 950-pattern sweep and a fuzz): no row said a wrong schedule; the overnight stretch was declared in continuity, unbounded lists of seconds were bounded, and rules a builder had guessed were written into the answers. The sentence forms the audit changed have had no blind fluency read; repaired a second time 2026-11-13 by Claude Fable 5.2 with the core's calendar facts, the cross-language trap list and usage notes written in Chinese: a schedule that never fires and one that fires only in leap years now say so, only the months that have a date are named, year sets with holes and stretches with their own steps are no longer lists, 工作日 and 和 between a date and a weekday were replaced on the notes' evidence, and where the rule book departs from the notes is recorded in its last section. None of the forms changed in either repair has had a blind fluency read; 2026-11-13: says when both day fields must match (a day field written from a star beside a restricted one, as in Vixie cron), in rows, rule and renderer written by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from this rule book's seed and reviewed by Claude Fable 5.2; a blind Sonnet reader told these sentences from the union's 16 times of 16, and none has had a blind fluency read; amended 2026-11-14 by Claude Opus 5.5 on the maintainer's rulings: an hour cadence that tiles the day is said by its step alone (每2小时一次, 每6小时一次; from a later start where the hours are too many to list, 自1点起每2小时一次), a minute or second with it is said as against every hour (每2小时的30分), its hours as stretches under a finer rhythm are 偶数小时内 / 奇数小时内 or 每6小时的第1个小时内, the bracket of hours after 偶数小时 and the bracket of years after a cadence of years are gone (the ends and the first year are said in words), and seconds that step evenly at one clock time or one minute are a window with the step. The answers were amended first and every affected row was rewritten by hand before the renderer changed; hours taken out of a tiling cadence are said as that cadence with the hours excepted (每2小时一次（8:00除外）, from five hours that fire), in rows written first and then the renderer; nothing was blind-read; amended a second time 2026-11-14 by Claude Opus 5.5 after two isolated readers briefed in Chinese (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5) read the bare step of hours as counted from when the task starts, 自1点起 as possibly 13:00, and 2点至22点的偶数小时的… as ending at 22:00: no cadence of hours is said by its step alone; every second hour of the day is 每天偶数整点 / 每天奇数小时的15分 / 每天偶数小时内，…, longer steps are listed or named, and the even or odd hours between two ends close on their first and last firing in one bracket (每天2点至22点，偶数小时的0分至29分，每分钟一次（首次2:00，末次22:29）). Rows first, then the answers, then the renderer; the same two readers read every new form one way. No blind fluency read
